subject.title: feat: retain iMessage tombstones and revisions

question: Should existing v0.1 archives keep replacement as the default `sync` behavior, with retention/merge opt-in, or should the project intentionally make merge-with-tombstones the default upgrade contract?
rationale: Both behaviors are plausible, but the branch changes what ordinary existing-user syncs retain and the repository evidence does not show prior maintainer approval for that migration policy.

options.title: Preserve replacement by default
options.body: Keep the current replacement behavior for ordinary `sync` and expose merge/tombstone retention through an explicit opt-in or separately approved migration path.

options.title: Adopt merge as the new default
options.body: Approve merge-by-default only with explicit upgrade documentation, compatibility tests, and real proof showing how existing archives recover or intentionally restore.

recommendation.title: Preserve replacement by default
recommendation.body: Keep the current replacement behavior for ordinary `sync` and expose merge/tombstone retention through an explicit opt-in or separately approved migration path.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied implementation history shows direct ownership of the proposed archive-contract direction, though current-main ownership evidence is limited.
